name: print-social-join-our-party-stories-navy-yellow-ring-photo-frames
title: 'Join Our Party Tonight' story set in navy with yellow ring photo frames and dot-grid accents
whatItIs: Ten navy vertical story cards with a recurring thick yellow ring shape framing party photos (clinking glasses, dancing, DJ lights), a small yellow dot grid, and bold yellow headlines ('Join Our Party Tonight', 'Let's Come Party', 'Feel the Music Now', 'Party Tonight Feel the Music').
whatItMeans: Energetic and consistent; the recurring ring frame gives varied nightlife photos one unified, recognisable brand shape.
techniques: Frame every photo with the same thick ring shape for consistency.
Use a dot grid as a light textural accent.
Keep a single bold accent colour against dark navy throughout.

vocabulary.definition: A thick circular outline used to crop and highlight a photo.
A pattern of small dots used as light background texture.
